name: Fountain
seo_title: Fountain Christmas Events for Kids 2026: 3 Events
seo_desc: Kids' Christmas in Fountain, CO: Magic of Lights, Nature Hikes with Santa at Fountain Creek Nature Center and Miracle on Main Street.
lede: Fountain does Christmas with a city tree lighting, a Miracle on Main Street gift morning for kids, Nature Hikes with Santa at the nature center and the Magic of Lights display on the raceway grounds.
celebrates: The City of Fountain keeps a 2026 Annual Events List that runs from a Fall Festival and Trunk-or-Treat to a Tree Lighting on November 20, from 6 to 7 pm, and Miracle on Main Street on December 12. Fountain UP, the group behind Miracle on Main Street, describes it as a chance for kids to shop for affordable gifts for their family. El Paso County Parks hosts Nature Hikes with Santa at Fountain Creek Nature Center, and Magic of Lights fills the Pikes Peak International Raceway grounds at 16650 Midway Ranch Road with holiday lights through January 2.
lastyear: Last December, El Paso County Parks hosted Nature Hikes with Santa at Fountain Creek Nature Center on Saturday, December 13, 2025, with sessions from 10 to 11:30 am and 1 to 2:30 pm. Kids joined an interactive reading of Twas the Night Before Christmas while waiting for Santa, then hiked with him to see what gifts nature gives us. Afterward the band Peppergrass played seasonal tunes and kids made paper snowflakes. The price was $5 per child, or $4 for a member child, with prepaid registration for a session.
facts: Magic of Lights Colorado Springs sets up at Pikes Peak International Raceway, 16650 Midway Ranch Road in Fountain, even though the name says Colorado Springs. Fountain Creek Nature Center, run by El Paso County Parks, is at 320 Pepper Grass Lane. The City of Fountain's website promotes a holiday Coloring Contest on its home page, and its events list shows Miracle on Main Street on December 12, the same day as Nature Hikes with Santa.
trains: The sources we checked show no passenger train service in Fountain, and Amtrak does not serve Colorado Springs. Holiday trains within reach of Fountain are the Royal Gorge Route Railroad in Cañon City, which lists a Santa Express Train from November 19 to December 30, 2026, and the Pikes Peak Cog Railway in Manitou Springs. The Cripple Creek and Victor Narrow Gauge Railroad is a longer drive to the west.

faq: What Christmas events can kids do in Fountain?

Fountain's family Christmas events in 2026 are Miracle on Main Street on December 12, Nature Hikes with Santa at Fountain Creek Nature Center on December 12 and Magic of Lights at Pikes Peak International Raceway, which runs from November 21 to January 2. The city's Tree Lighting was on November 20. Each listing on this page links to the host.
Does Fountain have a Christmas parade?

We did not find a Fountain Christmas parade on the City of Fountain's 2026 events list, which shows a Tree Lighting on November 20 and Miracle on Main Street on December 12. Check the city's events calendar for updates. The big parade in the area is the Festival of Lights Parade in downtown Colorado Springs on December 5.

Magic of Lights is at Pikes Peak International Raceway, 16650 Midway Ranch Road, Fountain, CO 80817. Our listing shows 43 dates from November 21, 2026 to January 2, 2027, with online prices from $8.50 per vehicle in November and a season pass listed at $92.99 per vehicle. Check the host page for current prices.
How much is Nature Hikes with Santa?

El Paso County Parks listed Nature Hikes with Santa at $5 per child, or $4 for a member child, in 2025, with prepaid registration for a specific session required. The 2026 hikes are Saturday, December 12, with sessions from 10 to 11:30 am and 1 to 2:30 pm. Check the host page for 2026 prices before you book.

intro_html:
Rally the corgi has sniffed out the best Christmas events for kids in Fountain for 2026, and here is what he found: 3 family events, none of them free. The magic runs from November 21 (Magic of Lights) through January 2, with Miracle on Main Street (December 12) and Nature Hikes with Santa (December 12) along the way. We check every date on the host's own website, and each listing links straight there.

What Rally found in Fountain

  • 3 Christmas events for kids in Fountain, 2 of them moved from the Colorado Springs page
  • Meet Santa: Nature Hikes with Santa at Fountain Creek Nature Center, December 12
  • Lights: Magic of Lights at Pikes Peak International Raceway, November 21 to January 2
  • Community morning: Miracle on Main Street at Fountain City Hall, December 12 (price not listed)
  • Season: November 21, 2026 to January 2, 2027

Planning a bigger day out? Fountain families also use our guide to Christmas activities for kids in Colorado Springs, which covers Electric Safari at Cheyenne Mountain Zoo, the Festival of Lights Parade and the Old Colorado City Christkindlmarket.
